summary: Off-registry mutable GitHub dependency enables install-time code execution
details: package.json declares the dependency `libsignal` as `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node`, a mutable GitHub reference with no commit SHA or version pin. On `npm install`, the dependency is resolved from the HEAD of that personal repository rather than from the npm registry, with no integrity check, no pinned version, and no signature verification. Whatever code is present at that repo's HEAD — including any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) inside it — will execute on the installer's machine during dependency installation. The repository owner can change the referenced code at any time after this package is published, so each future install of @wanzforme/bails@5.0.0 may fetch and execute different content than earlier installs received.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
